  "phoneNote": "The smile motif and clinic photography feel business-specific, but generous hero gaps delay the photo and repeated contact details make the bottom unnecessarily long.",

  "fixes": [
    "Keep contact details in the dark appointment section; remove their repetition from the footer and retain only legal information and utility links.",
    "Reduce the phone hero’s gaps around “Pišite nam” to bring the photograph higher, and compact the desktop services layout so its left column does not sit empty beside most of the list.",
    "Reduce desktop section-heading sizes and replace the enormous footer business name with a restrained brand signature."

    "Phone: the footer repeats the address, telephone and email already presented in the immediately preceding contact section."
